# Fire & Wok

> Authentic Chinese restaurant and takeaway in the heart of Peterborough city centre at 36 Cowgate, PE1 1NA. Dine-in, collection and delivery, open daily 12:00–22:00.

Fire & Wok specialises in wok-fired Cantonese and Szechuan cuisine — aromatic shredded duck, salt & pepper dishes, hand-tossed chow mein and a 3-course signature set menu (£31 per person, minimum 2 people). A dedicated gluten-free menu is available. Reservations via TheFork; delivery and collection orders via the online ordering portal.

## Visit & Contact
- Address: 36 Cowgate, Peterborough, Cambridgeshire PE1 1NA, United Kingdom
- Phone: +44 1733 813001
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 12:00–22:00
- Cuisines: Chinese, Cantonese, Szechuan
- Price range: ££
- Payment: Cash, debit/credit card, contactless
- Reservations: Yes, walk-ins welcome
- Service: Dine-in, collection, delivery

## Signature Dishes
- Aromatic Shredded Duck with pancakes (quarter £14.00, half £26.00) with cucumber, scallion, hoisin
- Fire & Wok Mixed Appetisers platter (£15.00 per person, minimum 2)
- Fire & Wok Special Chow Mein (£10.00)
- Sweet & Sour Harmony Chicken (£9.50)
- Kung Pao Blaze Chicken, hot, contains nuts (£9.50)
- Szechuan Spice Chicken / Beef (£9.50 / £10.50)
- Grilled Sea Bass with Coconut Curry Sauce (£11.50)
- Buddha Delight, vegetarian (£10.00)
- Salt & Pepper Tofu, vegetarian (£7.50)

## Gluten-Free Menu
Selected starters, mains, rice and vermicelli chow mein prepared gluten free, e.g. Chicken Salt & Pepper (£7.50), Chicken with Black Bean Symphony (£9.50), Scallion Beef Steak (£10.50), Roast Duck in Plum Sauce (£9.50), Chicken Vermicelli Chow Mein (£8.50).
